# Seed 92 on the AMD Ryzen 7 PRO 8840HS - the new series' first run: the five programs' code in the size, step 3's genes (Iteration 698)

`seed 92 14h` at 181bc365a3. The chain: done. 49,601 designs, generations 0-166: 30,584 ok, 10,725 stopped after one round, 8,266 screened, 17 died: application size (gc16), 7 wrong output: apps, 1 died: varcall 0 - retired (Iteration 592); s4 is frozen (stages/frozen), 1 died: doesfar 0 - retired (Iteration 593); s5 is frozen (stages/frozen); 3,542 designs an hour.

**The fixed-box hypervolume**: true front 386 (385 inside the box), hypervolume 0.31386 | fastest 0.1277, smallest 22417, least memory 112 KB, fastest at 32 bits 0.1617. **The stopping rule** (stopping.py, results/stopping-series.md): verdict: seed 92 opens the series - nothing earlier to gain on the count: 1 run(s) on the method; the earliest stop after seed 94, if every run until then gains nothing



**The extremes**: fastest 7b61210665 0.1277, smallest 08087f8041 22,417 bytes, least memory 112 KB, fastest at 32 bits b7fb1dabf2 0.1617.

**The verdict** (rule 1): no comparison step in the chain - the run's front alone (Iteration 427); it opens the series
from seed 92 (the size with the five programs' code, 678/686, and step 3's genes): nothing earlier on the method to gain
on - the earliest stop after seed 94. No prediction was due (697 wrote none).

**Step 3's genes** (results/drafts/newgenes-seed92.py, its output results/drafts/newgenes-seed92.txt; as expressed): each
below its children's share on the true front - rtvar 2 of 386 (0.9 % of the children, enrichment 0.59), rtconst 17
(0.62), rtinline 32 (0.53; 8 of the fastest tenth), jitvar 18 (0.49), jitdoes 2 (0.44); none in the smallest or
leanest tenth. Pairs alive with the same expressed genome but for the gene: rtinline 0.959 of the speed (238 pairs;
ackermann 0.90, bubble 0.82, corpus 1.05) for +673 bytes; rtconst 0.982 (bubble 0.82) for +332; rtvar 0.988 (apps
0.91) for +712; jitvar 0.995 for +176; jitdoes 1.000 for +324. Each a speed-for-bytes trade, as the rehearsal had it
(696: 0.94-1.01 at 0.8-1.6 KB); the run took rtinline at the fast end and little else.

**The held-out code** (lab/evolve/heldout-code.py, new - the plan's "each processing reports them"; output
results/drafts/heldout-code-seed92.txt): 78 front designs (every fifth by score, the extremes), wordfreq, minif and
brainless's code bytes at 8-byte cells, the selection's re-counted equal to the records' for 78 of 78. The selection's
code against the held-out code, Spearman 0.813; the score against the score with the held-out code added 0.992; the
small end's regret 0 bytes (400d9867fe, 22,417 + 44,316). No sign the size score fits the five.

**A reader fault, found here and fixed**: since 678 a record's first key is `app`, so the report's JSON lines begin
`{"app"`, and every tool finding them by `startswith('{"bin"')` found none - seed-facts.py printed an empty front, and
gate.py would have checked no run design. Eleven readers now take a line beginning `{"` holding `"genome": {`
(evolve.py's newest_front and recorded_genome, gate.py, seed-facts.py, progress-table.py, xcheck.py, engines-check.py,
gene-equiv.py, gene-table-test.py, gene-interactions.py, tools/arm-cross-check.py, tools/vmtrace.py), before the gate
ran. The report's column "binary + image" now holds binary + image + app (the score).

**The deaths' causes**: 24, all the 16-bit families past their reach, each refused out loud - checked on this tree
(results/drafts/deaths-verify-698.py, its output results/drafts/deaths-verify-698.txt): 7 sod16 wrong output on apps,
"sod16: DOES> tail beyond 128 KB" in shellmix's load (693's limit; s1-sod16 and six children of it, all the same output);
17 cpt16 with no reading of gc16's code, "call out of reach ROOTS" (the 16-bit call reach; the other four programs
counted). deaths-check.py first left the 7 open and called the 17 "right here" - it ran 678's measure as a workload
named "application"; now it rebuilds "died: application size" with app_size, and lists both causes as expected (698),
its self-test and an --all rebuild of one of each confirming.

# Evolved VM designs

41335 designs evaluated, 30584 alive, 8266 screened - not measured (Iteration 200). Speed is the geometric mean of median cpu time / hand-made s6, long workloads (Iteration 100) over kernel, fib, corpus, loop, bubble, ackermann, apps,
relative to s6-cv8b; size is the self-hosting image, binary the stripped engine. sieve, parse is held out.
The front is over three objectives, equal (Iteration 75): speed, binary + image, peak memory - memory within 8 KB a tie (Iteration 77).


The Q-best design (binary + image x run time x memory - the knee; information): 48c12237f9, speed 0.315, binary + image 29,969, memory 124 KB - Q 0.260 of s6-cv8b's.
